reasoning: The question asks whether the US experienced a recession by end of Q4 2025, defined as two consecutive negative quarters. Evidence shows Q4 2025 GDP grew 1.4% annualized (down from Q3's 4.4%), and full-year 2025 GDP was 2.2%. No evidence indicates negative GDP in either Q3 or Q4 2025. The slowdown was attributed to temporary factors (government shutdown, export weakness) rather than structural recession. Economists expect rebound in early 2026. The New York Fed estimates only 20.4% recession probability by December 2026. Since both Q3 and Q4 2025 showed positive growth, the resolution criteria (two consecutive negative quarters) were not met.
